mapper.sql: select DISTINCT u.user_id, u.user_name, u.user_type, u.nick_name, i.enforcement, i.adopt ,i.login , i.create_by, i.create_time,i.update_by, i.update_time from sys_user u left join sys_dept d ON FIND_IN_SET(d.DEPT_ID,u.DEPT_ID) left join sys_enforcement_info i ON i.user_id = u.user_id
mapper.insert: insert into sys_enforcement_info( user_id, enforcement, adopt, login, create_by, create_time )values( #{userId}, #{enforcement}, #{adopt}, #{login}, #{createBy}, now() )
